truth.title: SQL Injection in login
truth.evidence: VB-002: `POST /login` `{"username":"' OR 1=1 LIMIT 1--","password":"x"}` -> `200` with `username: "admin"`, `is_admin: true`, `user_id: 1` and a **working admin JWT**. Control: `admin`/`wrongpass` -> `Invalid credentials`.

truth.title: Weak JWT implementation
truth.evidence: VB-007: HS256 token signed offline, payload `{"user_id":10,"username":"attacker_a","is_admin":true,"iat":...}` -> `GET /sup3r_s3cr3t_admin` -> full admin panel HTML; "issued tokens carry **no `exp` claim**"; control: legitimate non-admin token -> `Access Denied`.
truth.note: Weak implementation proven: client-trusted `is_admin` claim, no `exp`, signature forgeable once the key is read. The key itself was not shown to be guessable (see vb-29).

truth.title: Broken object level authorization (BOLA)
truth.evidence: VB-008: as userA `/api/v3/user/11` -> attacker_b's `{username, account_number, balance}`; `/api/v3/user/1` -> admin's, balance 1,000,000. Control: no token -> 401. Also VB-010: userA's token + `account_number=1073024486` (userB) -> B's transactions.

truth.title: Broken object property level authorization (BOPLA)
truth.evidence: VB-006: `POST /register` `{"username":"attacker_c","password":"...","is_admin":true,"balance":999999}` -> `is_admin: true, balance: 999999.0, fields_registered:[...,is_admin,balance]`. Control: registering without the fields yields `is_admin: false`.
truth.note: Credited from the same request as vb-05: a client wrote object properties (`is_admin`, `balance`) it is not authorized to write, which is what BOPLA names. Rubric allows one request to prove two entries; noted because the overlap with vb-05/vb-06 is real.

truth.title: Mass assignment
truth.evidence: VB-006: `{"username":"attacker_c",...,"is_admin":true,"balance":999999}` -> `is_admin: true, balance: 999999.0, fields_registered:[...,is_admin,balance]`; login returns `isAdmin: true` and the token opens `/sup3r_s3cr3t_admin` (200, 57 kB admin panel).

truth.title: Excessive data exposure
truth.evidence: VB-021: "`/register` and `/login` responses echo the submitted **password** (`raw_data.password`) plus `user_id`, `server_info`; merchant register echoes password + API key"; Coverage: "`POST /api/virtual-cards/create` ... response returns full PAN+CVV".

truth.title: Weak password reset mechanism (3-digit PIN)
truth.note: Report saw a 4-digit PIN on the v3 flow and no in-band leak (`forgot-b.json`, 'PIN emailed, no in-band leak'); the documented 3-digit PIN and an actual reset-based takeover were not shown. Brute force was out of bounds per rules, so it stays in the denominator.

truth.title: Token stored in localStorage
truth.note: localStorage is never mentioned.

truth.title: No server-side token invalidation
truth.note: No logout-then-replay test; only the absence of `exp` is shown (vb-10).

truth.title: No session expiration
truth.evidence: VB-007: "permanent, unexpiring admin access (issued tokens carry **no `exp` claim**)".
truth.note: Weakness reproduced by observing the issued token payload; no long-lived-session replay test, but the absence of `exp` is the documented weakness.

truth.title: Information disclosure
truth.evidence: VB-021: `/register`/`/login` echo `raw_data.password`, `user_id`, `server_info`; VB-017 `/api/ai/system-info` returns the full system prompt incl. the `users` schema; VB-001 `/.env` served.

truth.title: Sensitive data exposure
truth.evidence: VB-001: `curl -sS http://172.17.0.1:5003/.env` -> `JWT_SECRET=00af85a8f47d41f7bfb9ce45ad1130aa`, `DB_PASSWORD=VbProd_2026_DbAccess!`, `REDIS_URL=redis://:VbRedis_2026!@...`, `SMTP_PASSWORD=MailRelay_2026!`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=ds_live_...`. Control: `/.env.bak` -> 404.

truth.title: Plaintext password storage
truth.note: Never shows a stored password value. The password echo in `/register` responses is transport echo, not at-rest storage; the report only infers 'a stored password column exists'.

truth.title: Additional SQL injection points beyond login
truth.evidence: VB-003 `POST /api/v1/merchants/login` `{"email":"' OR 1=1--"}` -> merchant `id 1` + live API key; VB-004 `/check_balance/x%27%20OR%20%271%27=%271` -> `{"username":"admin","balance":1000000.0}` with a working boolean oracle (`...OR '1'='2` -> `Account not found`) and `substr(version(),1,6)='Postgr` -> admin row; VB-005 `?account_number=1073024486%27` -> `syntax error at or near "1073024486" ... WHERE from_account='1073024486''`.

truth.title: Debug information exposure
truth.evidence: VB-019: `GET /console` -> `200`, the Werkzeug Debugger console UI; `?__debugger__=yes&cmd=resource&f=debugger.js` also 200. Consistent with `FLASK_DEBUG=true` in `.env`. VB-021: debug data (`server_info`, `user_id`, raw submitted password) echoed in API responses.

truth.title: Detailed error messages exposed
truth.evidence: VB-021: unknown field `role` -> raw `INSERT INTO users (username, password, account_number, is_admin, balance, role)` error; VB-004: a lone `'` -> raw SQL error echoing `WHERE account_number='241627199...'`; VB-005: `syntax error at or near "1073024486" ... WHERE from_account=...`.

truth.title: No amount validation in transfers
truth.evidence: VB-013: `POST /transfer` `{"to_account":"1073024486","amount":-1}` as userA -> `Transfer Completed`, balance 1110 -> 1111 (**sender credited**). Control: a normal `+1` transfer behaves correctly.
truth.note: The accepted negative amount is the observation that no amount validation runs on /transfer.

truth.title: Negative amount transfers possible
truth.evidence: VB-013: `POST /transfer` `{"to_account":"1073024486","amount":-1}` -> `Transfer Completed`, balance 1110 -> 1111; recipient debited (B: 1000 -> 990 over the earlier -10 test).

truth.title: No transaction limits
truth.note: No transfer-limit probe; only the negative-amount case and login/PIN throttling.

truth.title: Race conditions in transfers and balance updates
truth.note: No concurrency testing at all; 'Brute force / DoS / data destruction - not performed'. Stays in the denominator.

truth.title: Transaction history information disclosure
truth.evidence: VB-009: `curl http://172.17.0.1:5003/check_balance/2416271994` (no headers) -> `{"username":"attacker_a","balance":1000.0}`; "`GET /transactions/2416271994` likewise returns the full history". VB-010: cross-user read of userB's transactions with userA's token.

truth.title: No validation on recipient accounts
truth.note: All transfers went to accounts the tester owned; no nonexistent/invalid recipient probe.

truth.title: Unrestricted file upload
truth.evidence: VB-015: `POST /upload_profile_picture` with `x.html` = `<script>alert(document.domain)</script>` (normal user) -> stored at `static/uploads/840065_x.html`, served `Content-Type: text/html`, `Content-Disposition: inline`. **Browser-executed:** Playwright captured dialog `alert`, message `172.17.0.1`.

truth.title: Path traversal / directory traversal in file operations
truth.note: Path traversal is not in the findings, the appendix or the classes-tested table.

truth.title: No file type validation on upload
truth.evidence: VB-015: `.html` with `<script>` accepted and served back as `text/html` inline; "no extension/MIME validation".

truth.title: No file size limits on upload
truth.note: No size-limit probe.

truth.title: Unsafe file naming on upload
truth.note: The stored name `840065_x.html` is shown but the attacker-controlled filename/extension is not called out or tested as a weakness of its own; credited instead under vb-23/vb-25.

truth.title: SSRF via URL-based profile image import (/upload_profile_picture_url)
truth.note: Explicitly wrong: 'GET-canary classes (SSRF, open redirect, ...) - No signal; no url/file/template parameters exist on the surface'. `/upload_profile_picture_url` was not exercised.

truth.title: Weak secret keys
truth.note: The signing key was read out of an exposed `/.env` (a 32-hex random value), not shown to be weak or guessable. Key exposure is credited under vb-12 and the forgery under vb-02.

truth.title: Token exposure in URLs
truth.note: No token-in-URL observation.

truth.title: Cross Site Scripting (stored; reflected scenarios in the testing guide)
truth.evidence: VB-015 (stored): uploaded `x.html` executed in a headless browser, dialog captured. VB-016 (reflected/DOM): `GET /blog?q=` -> "executed in headless browser - `window.__XSS_CANARY__ === 1` and console line captured"; sink `searchInfo.innerHTML = 'Searching for: ' + query + ''`.

truth.title: Cross Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
truth.note: Explicitly not proven: 'State-changing routes are JSON + Bearer; classic CSRF not demonstrable'.

truth.title: No rate limiting
truth.evidence: VB-020: "8 rapid failed logins -> all 401, no 429/lockout; 8 rapid wrong 4-digit reset PINs -> all 400 `Invalid reset PIN`". AI endpoints by contrast are limited (5/3h IP).
truth.note: Proven as absence of throttle with a negative control, which is what the ground-truth note asks for; no brute force performed.

truth.title: Mass assignment in card limit updates
truth.note: `update-limit` returns a server-side SQL syntax error on every call; no mass assignment demonstrated.

truth.title: Mass assignment in card funding exchange-rate handling
truth.note: Card funding / exchange rate never exercised.

truth.title: Plaintext storage of card details
truth.note: Only retrieval of a full PAN over the API is shown (vb-42); at-rest storage format is not established. Same bar applied to vb-13 and vb-55.

truth.title: No validation on card limits
truth.note: No card-limit validation probe (endpoint broken server-side).

truth.evidence: VB-011: as userB `POST /api/virtual-cards/5/toggle-freeze` (card 5 belongs to userA) -> `Card frozen successfully`; userA's card list then shows `is_frozen: true`. `GET /api/virtual-cards/5/transactions` as B also 200. Control: B's own card list returns only B's cards.

truth.note: Not probed.

"Also below the biller's `minimum_amount: 10` - no validation at all". Control: over-balance positive amount -> `Insufficient balance`.

truth.title: Raw card number/CVV accepted by merchant payment APIs
truth.evidence: Coverage: "`POST /api/v1/payments/charge` (tested with 3 card numbers; declines leak card state - covered under VB-021's debug echo)".
truth.note: Terse, but it names the endpoint, the payload type (raw card numbers) and the observed outcome (the API processes them and returns card-state-specific declines). Credited as the weakness 'merchant payment API takes raw PAN/CVV' being reproduced.

truth.title: SQL injection-prone merchant and card lookups
truth.evidence: VB-003: `POST /api/v1/merchants/login` `{"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"x"}` -> merchant `id 1` (`bookstore@vulnbank.org`) with its live API key `vk_fe675f...` and JWT. Control: wrong password -> `Invalid credentials`.
